name: Silver Age (Lee/Kirby/Thomas)
description: X-Men #1 (1963) through the original run's cancellation at #66. The first five students and the founding Xavier/Magneto conflict.

name: Claremont Era
description: Giant-Size X-Men #1 (1975) through Chris Claremont's departure after X-Men #3 (1991). The all-new team, Phoenix, Days of Future Past, the Brood, Inferno.

name: 90s / Blue-Gold
description: Jim Lee's X-Men relaunch through the Onslaught and Apocalypse: The Twelve era. Rogue and Gambit, the Blue and Gold teams, Age of Apocalypse.

name: Morrison / Whedon Era
description: New X-Men (2001–2004) and Astonishing X-Men (2004–2008). Emma Frost joins, Jean dies, the school becomes a school.

name: Utopia / Schism
description: The X-Men move to San Francisco and then the island Utopia; Cyclops and Wolverine split the team; Avengers vs. X-Men.

name: Bendis to Gold/Blue
description: All-New X-Men and the time-displaced originals, Death of X, the Gold/Blue era and the Rogue–Gambit wedding.

name: Krakoan Age
description: House of X / Powers of X (2019) through Fall of the House of X (2024). Mutant nation-state on the living island Krakoa; resurrection; the Quiet Council.

name: From the Ashes
description: Post-Krakoa relaunch (July 2024 onward). Teams scattered across Alaska, New York and elsewhere.

name: Lee / Ditko / Romita (Spider-Man)
description: Amazing Fantasy #15 through the death of Gwen Stacy in Amazing Spider-Man #121–122.

name: Bronze Age Spider-Man
description: Post-Gwen; MJ's growth, Black Cat, the black costume, and the wedding in Amazing Spider-Man Annual #21 (1987).

name: Venom to Clone Saga
description: Venom's debut (ASM #300), the Clone Saga (1994–96), Norman Osborn's return.

name: Straczynski to Brand New Day
description: Aunt May learns the truth; Civil War unmasking; One More Day erases the marriage; Brand New Day; the Ultimate universe's Miles Morales.

name: Superior Spider-Man and after
description: Otto Octavius as Spider-Man, Secret Wars, Miles in 616, Spencer's run, and the 2020s.

name: Marvel Age (Avengers / FF / Thor)
description: Fantastic Four #1 through the end of Lee/Kirby. The Avengers assemble, Cap returns, Galactus comes.

name: Bronze Age (Avengers / FF / street)
description: Kree–Skrull War, Korvac, the Pym scandal, Miller's Daredevil, Byrne's FF, Starlin's Thanos.

name: Late 80s and 90s (Avengers / FF)
description: Infinity Gauntlet, Operation: Galactic Storm, Heroes Reborn, Onslaught.

name: Bendis Avengers / Civil War
description: Avengers Disassembled, New Avengers, House of M, Civil War, Secret Invasion, Siege, Dark Reign.

name: Hickman to Secret Wars
description: Avengers / New Avengers incursions, Infinity, Time Runs Out, Secret Wars (2015).

name: Post-Secret Wars
description: All-New All-Different Marvel, Civil War II, Secret Empire, Empyre, and the 2020s.
